newsitem.title: FRANCE: Sri Lanka president to visit France next week.
newsitem.headline: Sri Lanka president to visit France next week.

text.p: President Chandrika Bandaranaike will next week become the first Sri Lanka leader to visit France officially, the French Foreign Ministry announced on Friday.
During her November 25-27 visit, Bandaranaike will have talks with President Jacques Chirac and French business leaders and visit the National Assembly.

The ministry said the visit was a major stage towards developing friendship and cooperation between two Indian Ocean countries. France has two territories in the Indian Ocean, the islands of Mayotte in the Comoros archipelago and La Reunion.

Ministry spokesman Jacques Rummelhardt said the visit was a tribute to the courage of Bandaranaike who was elected in 1994 on a platform of returning peace to the island rent by fighting with Tamil separatists.
